title: Casting Shop Note on the Recasting Premium by Metal
content:
# Casting Shop Note on the Recasting Premium by Metal

Where a change is agreed on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, the premium added for the metal the piece is to be made in turns on that metal and on whether a casting stage stands recorded on the commission.

## The premiums

- Where the piece is to be made in platinum or in palladium and a casting stage stands recorded on the commission, the studio's platinum recasting premium of 9 per cent is added on the value of the work the customer has committed to.
- Where the piece is to be made in an eighteen karat gold and a casting stage stands recorded on the commission, the studio's gold recasting premium of 4 per cent is added on that value.
- Otherwise nothing is added for the metal the piece is to be made in.

## Which metals fall where

| Group | Metals |
|---|---|
| Platinum or palladium | Platinum 950; palladium 500 |
| An eighteen karat gold | 18-karat yellow gold; 18-karat white gold; 18-karat rose gold |
| Neither | 14-karat yellow gold; 14-karat white gold |

The metal the piece is to be made in stands on the commission record. A casting stage stands recorded where a casting stage entry has been booked to the commission; where none has, nothing is added for the metal whatever the metal is.

## Readings (hypothetical)

On a value of the work committed to of USD 3000.00 with a casting stage recorded: a piece in platinum 950 carries USD 270.00; a piece in 18-karat rose gold carries USD 120.00; a piece in 14-karat white gold carries nothing. The same commissions with no casting stage recorded carry nothing for the metal.
